== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Crimson Vault, also known as Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus, is a unique [[Territory]] that serves as the exclusive domain of the [[Kings of Damasca]]. Access to this realm is restricted by bloodline, as only those of the royal lineage possess the ability to open its [[Gates]]. [[Travelers]] can only manifest a Gate to the Crimson Vault from within the primary world, rather than from other Territories. A notable characteristic of travel to this location is that any entrance via a Gate leads specifically to the royal palace in [[Cana]]. The Vault's physical appearance is defined by a rough [[stone]] cavern containing silver double doors. These doors are decorated with the detailed portrait of an ancient, one-eyed, bearded king and are flanked by torches that emit an unnatural crimson light. Beyond these doors lies a long marble gallery featuring rows of shelves that hold various powerful weapons. Historically, the Crimson Vault was used by the first [[King of Damasca]] to seal away a destructive force to protect his kingdom. This seal is maintained through an annual [[blood]] [[sacrifice]]. The territory is noted for containing highly potent weaponry, though using these items often comes with a significant cost. The Vault is also associated with the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] and has been described as a place of great danger, once forbidden by the people of [[Elysia]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Crimson Vault serves as the origin of the red [[stone]] embedded in King [[Zakareth's eye]] and is illuminated by unnatural scarlet torches. While the prophecy of the Rising Sun foretells the end of its reign, the location can only be accessed through a Gate opened within the world rather than the Territories. This massive cave-like space, characterized by its silver doors and red-burning torches, contains various fragments. Although [[Talos]] eventually used red light to open a Gate to the site, the silver doors were later discovered cracked open. Notably, [[Leah]]'s appointment as [[Successor]] was sworn in the presence of the Vault before she departed from both the site and her father.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Crimson Vault is an ancient, [[blood]]-red stretch of rock that was once forbidden by [[Elysia]] due to its extreme danger. This territory, which features silver doors carved with the face of a one-eyed king, serves as a gateway to Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus and once housed the [[Lightning Spear]]. Within its halls, weapons are displayed on marble shelves and blades can be sealed, though the location may also harbor enemies. During various encounters, scarlet light [[chains]] have burst from the site and its power has even scattered [[Indirial]]'s strength. While [[Zakareth]] once departed this location to find his palace in ruins, [[Kai]] now intends to tear the territory apart.}}
